main_idea: On-policy distillation improves GDPval performance across two model families.
ideas: Nemotron gains +20.9% net win-loss margin and 5.1 rubric points.
Qwen gains +21.4% net win-loss margin and 7.9 rubric points.
Nemotron wins 123 of 220 GDPval task comparisons.
summary: The long subtitle and repeated model recipe details add clutter; the graphic has the information needed to understand the results.
